newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades paper sector.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades paper sector.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it is recommending that investors overweight stocks in the paper and forest products industry.
-- said has been cautious on the group since the fall of 1995.
-- said global capacity growth trends appear to be brightening for the period 1998 to 2000.

-- said top four stock picks in this sector include Mead Corp, Buckeye Cellulose Corp, Jefferson Smurfit Corp, which were raised to a strong buy from a buy, and Weyerhaeuser Co, which was raised to a buy from a hold.

-- Salomon also said it raised the following stocks to buy from hold: Aracruz Celulose, Boise Cascade Corp, Consolidated Papers Inc, International Paper Co, Temple-Inland Inc, Union Camp Corp and Georgia-Pacific Corp.
